Backups

Daily backup

Saved toChecking…
How backups work
Once a day, the first time the app is opened, it quietly saves a fresh Excel and JSON backup — no need to click anything. By default that goes into your standard Backups folder, same as "Back up now". Pick a different folder below (e.g. a network drive) to send the daily backup there instead — a "Ledger backups" folder is created inside it. If that folder can't be found on a given day, the backup is saved to the standard Backups folder instead, and you'll see a warning. If you have a spreadsheet, master Orders file or Menu Backup file linked, a copy of each is saved alongside the daily backup too — only the ones actually linked. Every 30 days, that period's daily backups are zipped into one dated "archive" file in the same folder and the loose daily copies are removed; "Back up now" backups are never included in this.

Send to support

Something gone wrong? This puts everything the app uses into one zip file: the backup, the ledger, the Master Order File, the Menu Backup file, the error log, the settings (without passwords), this computer's own details, the last 7 daily backups and a picture of the app. It goes in a folder called Error next to the ledger on your network drive.
Test app: pick a support zip to set this app up the same as the computer that sent it. A backup of the test app is made first. The ledger, Master Order File and Menu Backup file are copied into Documents › Chequers test app › Backups › Support copies and only those copies are used.

Saving

Slower computerOn for a slower computer or a laptop with 8 GB of memory: while you work, it saves to the ledger at most every 2 minutes, so the computer keeps up. Off for a normal computer: it saves 30 seconds after your last change and checks the ledger straight after.

Version history

Every version

    Start again

    Reset app dataClears every item, recipe, supplier and saved order stored on this computer, and unlinks any spreadsheet — so the app opens completely empty, exactly like a brand-new install, until you link or import a file again. Take a "Back up now" first if you want to keep a copy.

    Error log

    The same message on the same day is shown once, with how many times. The text file itself is unchanged.

    Set a Biomatrix Lock password

    This locks the screen with a password — it doesn't encrypt anything already stored. Choose something you (and whoever else uses this) will remember; there's no reset if it's lost, short of turning the whole thing off and back on via Reset app data.

    Turn off Biomatrix Lock?

    Ordering, Suppliers, Menu Item Recipe and Batch Recipe will always be open again, same as before this was turned on. Enter your current password to confirm.

    Enter password to unlock

    Locks again on its own once that time passes, even if the app's still open — or straight away if the app is closed first, whichever comes first.

    Zero quantity on this order

      Items not in the ledger

      Order sent?

      Reset app data?

      This does three things, in order: (1) saves a full backup of everything to a .json file automatically, (2) unlinks every linked spreadsheet — the main ledger, the master Orders file, and the Menu Backup file — without ever writing to, changing, or removing anything in any of them, and (3) clears everything stored in this app on this computer. Afterwards you'll need to link your spreadsheets again yourself.

      Print Stock Count & Order sheet

      Remove suppliers with no items

      These suppliers have no items in the app. Tick the ones to remove. Names that are only numbers (usually product codes brought in by mistake) are ticked already.
      Ticked suppliers are taken out of the app and off the Master Order File's Suppliers tab. Their empty headings in the ledger are cleared back to blank spare rows, with a backup copy of the ledger saved first. Past orders stay in the history.

      Merge supplier

      Delete this supplier?

      This removes the supplier from your list. It doesn't touch any Order Sheet items already filed under it, or delete its saved order history. This can't be undone.

      Check this import

      Import complete

      Import past orders

      Found order history for these suppliers in the file. Tick whichever ones you want brought back into the app — orders already saved here are never duplicated.

      New Suppliers Found

      Your linked master Orders file has supplier details this app doesn't have yet. Rows that clearly match an existing supplier are merged in automatically; anything that looks like it might already be on your list is flagged below for you to check before it's added.

      Restore from backup

      Pick an old daily backup to look at. Anything in it that's since been deleted here is listed below, tab by tab — tick what you want back and click Restore. Nothing else about that day's backup is touched, and nothing currently in the app is changed except what you tick.

      Order Sheet supplier check

      Some supplier names already on your Order Sheet don't exactly match your Suppliers list. Match each one to the correct existing supplier, or add it as a genuinely new one — your choice is remembered, so the Order Sheet recognises it automatically from now on. Your Suppliers list is always the one treated as correct.
